_help: "players": "all" gives every Husker on the NFL Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3, MLB and NBA lists a page. Add "overrides": {"Player Name": "Exact Wikipedia Article Title"} when the automatic lookup picks the wrong article or misses one. A plain name applies to NFL Tier 1; for the other lists write the key as "tier-2:Player Name", "tier-3:Player Name", "baseball:Player Name" or "basketball:Player Name". An override is trusted even if the article does not mention Nebraska, so check it is the right person. Use "none" as the title to stop a wrong article from being linked.
